note: The author's 2026-11-23 statement that space is open in the static view but not 100 % open in the dynamic view (AUTHOR_PROPOSITION §4). Capacity = Gibbons-Hawking entropy of the final de Sitter horizon; region = inside today's cosmic event horizon. The black-hole mass density and typical mass are illustrative AI inputs from memory, not a data comparison (the fraction scales with the typical mass). Nearest theory: Gibbons-Hawking entropy, generalised second law, cosmic entropy budget (Frampton et al. 2008; Egan and Lineweaver 2010). Not UET-distinct.
